title: The Chapel on Sycamore

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Just off the Square in Downtown Decatur, The Chapel on Sycamore is the perfect place to host your corporate event. Large enough for a company-wide party, yet flexible enough to be scaled down for smaller presentations, team-building activities, break-out sessions or whatever you need to help your company achieve success. We have in-house AV (screen, projector and sound) for seamless set up. The building is an architectural treasure with its main hall, soaring arched wood beam ceilings, hardwood floors and roll down wood doors. blurb: The Chapel on Sycamore is a privately owned and operated event space located in downtown Decatur, GA. Centrally located just miles from downtown Atlanta, our location is easily accessible to metro Atlanta, including DeKalb, Fulton, Gwinnett, and Cobb counties.
